name: roadmap-prioritizer
description: Read an existing codebase, generate fresh opportunity ideas (JTBD framing, How Might We, SCAMPER, value/risk grid) alongside the candidates already hinted at in code and docs, agree on the combined list, then pick the prioritization model that actually fits — RICE, MoSCoW, Now/Next/Later or Kano — and run it as an interactive conversation into a roadmap with status and priority per feature.
